name: SIMD Sphere/Frustum Culling
definition: A culling technique to reject non-overlapping spheres by checking if the sphere center is contained within an enlarged bounding frustum. This avoids unnecessary ray/sphere intersection tests caused by discretization artifacts or spheres smaller than the maximum radius rmax.
summary: SIMD Sphere/Frustum Culling rejects non-overlapping spheres by testing if their centers lie within an enlarged frustum, distinguishing itself from shaft culling by accommodating spheres that lack planar edges.
